extracted.intended_audience: patent owners / patent practitioners filing or waiving a Patent Owner Preliminary Response (POPR) in USPTO PTActs for IPR or PGR AIA reviews
extracted.subtask_description: Step‑by‑step instructions for filing—or waiving—a Patent Owner Preliminary Response (POPR) via the USPTO PTActs web interface for IPR or PGR (AIA) proceedings. Covers navigation, selecting the case, choosing the filing or waiver option, form entry, public availability confirmation, submission, and verification of success.

rubrics_metrics.name: Access PTActs and sign in
rubrics_metrics.description: Navigate to https://ptacts.uspto.gov/ptacts/ui/home and select 'Sign in' (page shows selecting 'Sign in' twice).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Begin by accessing the PTActs home URL and completing the sign‑in process before attempting to file or waive a POPR.

rubrics_metrics.name: Locate the appropriate IPR or PGR Pending AIA Reviews tab
rubrics_metrics.description: Find the appropriate IPR or PGR Pending AIA Reviews tab in the PTActs interface.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the Pending AIA Reviews section to surface cases eligible for preliminary responses; this is the tab from which you select the target case.

rubrics_metrics.name: Select the appropriate case via AIA Review # hyperlink
rubrics_metrics.description: Select the appropriate case via the hyperlink in the 'AIA Review #' column.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Click the case hyperlink in the AIA Review # column to open the specific case record you intend to file the POPR for.

rubrics_metrics.name: Open +Add menu and choose filing or waiver action
rubrics_metrics.description: Click the '+Add' button to display the dropdown menu and select the appropriate option: 'File a Preliminary Response' or 'Waive a preliminary response'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the +Add dropdown to initiate either filing a POPR or submitting a waiver; choose the correct option depending on whether you intend to submit a response or waive it.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complete form fields (note pre-populated fields)
rubrics_metrics.description: Fill out the remaining fields as appropriate. Note: the 'Filing party' field, 'Preliminary response type' and 'Paper type' field are pre-populated and not editable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enter required metadata and any document attachments. Do not attempt to edit the specified pre-populated fields; confirm other fields are accurate before adding to the list.

rubrics_metrics.name: Add to List
rubrics_metrics.description: Select 'Add to List' after completing the form fields.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use 'Add to List' to stage the prepared submission (or waiver) prior to confirming public availability and final submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Set and confirm public availability
rubrics_metrics.description: If you select public availability, confirm document availability in the modal by selecting 'Yes, make it public' (if you select 'No, change availability', complete steps 8-9 as appropriate).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be deliberate about public availability: confirm the modal choice. If changing availability to non‑public, follow the indicated return steps to adjust fields and re‑add to list as needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submit and verify success
rubrics_metrics.description: Select 'Submit'. After submission, notice the successful message and observe that the case status is updated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Confirm receipt via the success notification and verify the case status has changed in PTActs to ensure the POPR filing or waiver was processed.

rubrics_metrics.name: POPR waiver follows same UI flow (choose 'Waive a preliminary response')
rubrics_metrics.description: To waive rather than file, follow the same sequence: sign in, select case, +Add → 'Waive a preliminary response', complete fields (with same pre-populated, non-editable fields), Add to List, confirm public availability, and Submit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The waiver workflow mirrors the filing workflow; ensure you explicitly select the 'Waive a preliminary response' option in the +Add menu and follow the same confirmation/submission steps.
